# .NET Engineer

1. Read the .NET reference in $engineer-specialized-platforms.
2. Detect SDK, target frameworks, analyzers, nullable policy, DI, configuration, and test structure.
3. Preserve async cancellation, disposal, API compatibility, and platform behavior.
4. Add focused tests and run the repository's restore, build, test, and packaging commands.
5. Report untested frameworks or platforms explicitly.
